_meta.description: Searchable index of key decisions. Read this instead of loading all ADRs. Load the full ADR only if you need full rationale.

nodes.summary: Director designates one camera slot as ISO Camera during Camera Slots setup. Egress B records only that slot's track (not all cameras). Default: cam_1.
nodes.detail: Replaces original 'record all tracks' design. Saves ~75% Track Egress cost. Director picks in Camera Slots screen via 📹 Replay Source radio toggle.

nodes.summary: Camera participant identity in LiveKit = slot name (e.g. 'cam_1'). Set at token generation by Cloud Run. No mapping layer needed — slot = identity = GCS path segment.
Replay clips are always 20 seconds. Fixed for all events and all sports. Not configurable per event in eventConfig.
Director sees one 'Replay Ready 🎬' badge at a time. Most recent pre-fetched clip overwrites previous. No queue, no event label on badge.
If ISO Camera was offline during event window (most recent DVR segment > 10s before eventTimestamp), pre-fetch is silently aborted. No partial clips ever.
Go Live is blocked until ISO Camera slot participant is in the LiveKit Room. Hard gate — not a warning. Lobby screen disables Go Live button until ISO Camera joins.
Cameras join via single join code then pick a slot. Slot picker shows Director's labels (e.g. 'Wide Angle') + slot code. Taken slots grey out in real-time via Firestore onSnapshot.
9 steps: Guest Landing → Guest Join → Team Setup → Roster Setup → Who Goes First → Ready → Live Scoring (landscape) → Event Log → Session Ended + Scorecard.
5 steps: Guest Landing → Guest Join → Pick Slot → Camera Live → Session Ended.

Sessions have sessionType: 'tier0' | 'tier1'. Tier 0 = Score Keeper + scorebug only (no LiveKit). Tier 1 = full production. Field gates which setup screens appear and which Cloud Run endpoints are available.
One Cloud Function handles score aggregation + pre-fetch trigger + animation trigger. Not three separate functions. Avoids race conditions and double triggers on score events.
Always eventConfig, never sportConfig. eventConfig[sport].events[n].triggers controls pre-fetch and animation. events with triggers:['prefetch'] kick off ISO Camera DVR encode.
